description: Look at a video in a video surface: returns frames as images, each labelled with its time, plus what is said in that span (transcribed and cached on first use). With no position you get an overview spread across the whole video. When someone points at a moment ("I don't like 1:34"), pass `at: "1:34"` to see the seconds around it; `start`/`end` show a range; `times` shows exact moments. Inside a span, `frames` sets how many, and `fps` sets a rate: the video's own frame rate over a short window shows every single frame. Up to 32 frames per call. Look at the overview first, then zoom in. Viewer role required.

at.description: A moment to look around. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

comment_id.description: Open a video comment: shows the moment it was left at (1 s each side) with the box the person drew outlined in red, plus what they wrote. Overrides surface_slug, video_id and the position args. Find them with list_comments target_type video_frame.

end.description: End of a range. Defaults to the end of the video. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

fps.description: Frames per second across the span instead of a count. Use the video's fps (returned in `video.fps`) to see every frame.

frames.description: How many frames across the span. Default 12 for an overview or range, 9 around `at`. Max 32.

include_transcript.description: Include what is said in the span. Default true.

size.description: Frame size: small 512px, medium 768px (default), large 1280px on the long side.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

start.description: Start of a range. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

video_id.description: The video's id, from list_videos. Optional when the surface holds a single video.

window.description: With `at`: seconds to show on each side. Default 2.

name: watch_video
